patch.value: Declare the schema capability so packed command flags activate

Packed-consumer acceptance (pm package install of the tarball) fails activation: registerCommand flags requires capability 'schema' in extension manifest capabilities. manifest.json currently declares capabilities [commands] only; registerLintCommand registers repeatable flags, so the manifest must also declare schema (capabilities: commands, schema). Verified against the packed tarball install path.

value.author: pi-glm-tooling
value.text: Packed-tarball verification found two more real-host contract gaps in the command registration, beyond the schema capability already described: (1) the real host derives allowed option keys from FlagDefinition.long by stripping exactly two leading dashes, so long: '--disable <value>' registers the key 'disable <value>' and every flag use fails with Unknown option '--disable' while the SDK testing harness accepts it; fix by declaring long without the value placeholder (for example long: '--disable', value_name: 'value'), and note FlagDefinition exposes list rather than repeatable for repeatable string flags (see pm-jev flags: long '--full', value_type, value_name). (2) the host readHandlerResultExitCode contract requires that a command result not carry an exit_code own property of 0: exit_code must be 1..255 and present only on failure, so runLintCommand must omit exit_code when the verdict passes (return the verdict without the exit_code key on success, keep exit_code: 1 when findings meet fail_on). The manifest.json schema capability is required for any registerCommand with flags: pm package install refused activation with hint 'registerCommand flags requires capability schema in extension manifest capabilities' until capabilities became [commands, schema]; that one-line manifest.json change is applied in the package worktree for verification and needs to be committed with the CLI work.
